Automatic scale-to-zero after 5s inactivity, resume from standby under 25ms even after weeks.
Preview URLs with your own custom domain.
The open source Blaxel migration skill gives agents the knowledge they need to migrate sandbox code from other providers to Blaxel.
Every sandbox is exposed via an MCP server that allows agents to operate it using tool calls.
you can optionally pin an agent or MCP server to a specific region by setting the region field in your blaxel.toml
Sandbox images allow you to create customized & reusable sandbox environments.
When you create a private preview URL a token is required to access the URL.
Agent Drive is a distributed filesystem that can be mounted to multiple sandboxes or agents at any time, including while they are already running.
Jobs allow you to run many AI tasks in parallel using batch processing.
MCP Server Hosting is a serverless computing service that allows you to host remote MCP servers without having to manage infrastructure.
API keys can be used in the Blaxel APIs, CLI and SDK.
The easiest way to integrate the Blaxel CLI into a CI pipeline is with the official Blaxel GitHub Action.
When deploying a resource on Blaxel, you sometimes have the option to choose the deployment region.

Install the Blaxel skill to give your agent the ability to deploy AI agents, create sandboxes for code execution, host MCP servers, run batch jobs, and more...all using simple prompts, zero code required!
Sandboxes resume from standby in under 25 milliseconds and automatically scale to zero after a few seconds of inactivity.
Execute and manage processes in your sandboxes with Blaxel SDK. Run shell commands, retrieve process information, and control process execution.
Read, write, list, and delete files inside a Blaxel sandbox using a simple file system interface from the SDK, MCP server, or REST API.
With this tool, you can **apply code changes** suggested by an LLM to your existing code files fast (2000+ tokens/second).
Retrieve process output logs from sandboxes in batch or real-time streaming mode using the Blaxel SDK in TypeScript, Python, or Go.
Create point-in-time snapshots of sandboxes, roll them back to a checkpoint, and fork them into new sandboxes.
Archive a sandbox to keep its filesystem while shutting it down, and unarchive it later to get it back.
Expose specific TCP ports on a Blaxel sandbox so external clients can connect to web servers, dev servers, or other services running inside it.
Operate Blaxel sandboxes directly from a frontend client using time-limited, scoped session tokens generated by your backend, with no proxy needed.
Configure expiration policies to automatically delete Blaxel sandboxes after inactivity, a TTL, or other conditions to control snapshot storage costs.
Run a command inside a Blaxel sandbox on a recurring cron schedule, a future datetime, or after a delay, with execution history per run.
Route outbound sandbox traffic through Blaxel's proxy with MITM header and body injection, inject secrets, and configure per-domain firewalls.
Restrict which external domains, HTTP methods, and URL paths a Blaxel sandbox can reach using allowlists and denylists to prevent data exfiltration and unwanted outbound traffic.
Attach Blaxel Volumes to sandboxes for persistent storage that survives sandbox destruction and recreation, with mount path configuration.
Scope everything a sandbox runs on your behalf to an unprivileged user while the sandbox API keeps the privileges it needs.
Configure environment variables and secrets in Blaxel sandboxes to securely manage API keys, credentials, and runtime configuration values.
Create reusable sandbox images with pre-configured tools, languages, and frameworks using Dockerfiles. Deploy new sandboxes from images in seconds.
Render an application in real-time through a direct preview URL backed by a running Blaxel sandbox, with optional auth and custom domains.
Agent Drive is a distributed filesystem mountable to multiple sandboxes or agents simultaneously, with concurrent read-write access and built-in replication.
Run batch processing tasks for AI workflows on Blaxel as scheduled or on-demand jobs that scale automatically and run on serverless infrastructure.
MCP Server Hosting is a **serverless computing service that allows you to host remote MCP servers** without having to manage infrastructure.
Blaxel employs two main authentication paradigms: **short-lived tokens** (OAuth) and **long-lived tokens** (API keys).
Every Blaxel sandbox exposes a built-in MCP server so agents can operate the sandbox using tool calls for files, processes, ports, and previews.
Configure label-based ACL rules on an Agent Drive to grant sandboxes, agents, or jobs read or read-write access, scoped to specific paths.
